name: Vidya Harikrishna Academy of Classical Music (VACM) - Music Classes in Wadala
description:
Vidya's Academy Of Classical Music conducts Carnatic Music Classes in Wadala. There are different levels as part of the curriculum in Carnatic vocal music along with theoretical knowledge.

At Vidya’s Academy of Classical Music (VACM), we aspire to continue this tradition by kindling the passion for Carnatic Vocal Music thereby nurturing the interest in students to take this art form on a professional level.

Our Director Smt. Vidya Harikrishna started teaching Carnatic Vocal Music in 2003 with a single student and since then the academy has grown by leaps and bounds. She believes that Carnatic Music is for all ages.

featured_reviews.name: Ankit Savla
featured_reviews.review_text:
I always had a keen interest in learning vocal music but never could pursue it until recently.
For the past 6 months I have been learning Carnatic vocals under the able guidance of Vidya Madam.
She has the most melodious voice, a superbly strong foundation of concepts and an incredibly humble human being.
As I don’t belong to south India, some pronunciations are difficult for me but Miss Vidya is both considerate and patient.
As I enjoy this musical journey of mine, I do consider myself incredibly lucky to have found a teacher like her!

featured_reviews.name: Jayalakshmi vasudevan
featured_reviews.review_text: Really proud to be the student of Mrs.Vidya Harikrishnasince 2004. Have gained abundant invaluable knowledge from her. She is extremely knowledgeable, kind-hearted, friendly, an excellent motivator, and teaches with complete dedication. She had guided me for my B. A. music course. My daughter is also learning from her since 2011. We had to travel for 2 hours each way to get to class every week, but we never cared about it because we knew that it was more than worth the effort and we couldn't possibly get a better teacher. We are blessed to have such a wonderful teacher. Our hearts are filled with gratitude towards her.

featured_reviews.name: DJsherry
featured_reviews.review_text: Its an honor to learn under such a talented and spiritually inclined teacher. She  has been very patient and supportive towards my learning process. you can literally feel the positivity in the academy. I am blessed to have her as my guru.

featured_reviews.name: Swetha K
featured_reviews.review_text: Ms Vidya has introduced Carnatic vocal to my 6 year old daughter who is enjoying every minute of the lesson. She inspires my daughter to practice regularly and do her best. As a teacher is very loving, warm yet firm with the children. Carnatic music has been an integral part of my growing up years and I am really happy that my daughter is now learning from one of the best teachers. Thank you.

featured_reviews.name: lakshmi narayan
featured_reviews.review_text:
A teacher teaches music – the curriculum, the techniques, the methods and so on, but a Guru is the one who teaches how to approach music: how to understand it, how to internalize it and how to enjoy it.
It is our good fortune that we were able to enroll our child in VACM run by Guru Smt. Vidya Harikrishna. Under her able guidance one can rest assured that the child's talent gets nurtured and supported in the right direction. Vidya madam extends her warmth and love to all the kids alike. It is a very individual attention that each child recieves from her. My child has grown really fond of madam. She enjoys her music classes and is always looking forward to be and learn from madam. There is adequate importance given to the wholesome growth and attitude of the child ,on the lines of promoting our rich cultural tradition. I think this is very essential for the overall growth of the musician in the child. Thanks for everything madam.

featured_reviews.name: Ramya Ganesan
featured_reviews.review_text: Its been less than a year since my daughter Ms. Vedhika Venkat started her classes with Miss. Vidya Hariharan. Though the classes are online, the imparting of knowledge to the kids has been great and miss takes very keen interest to get the basics right for the children. She is very thorough and teaches the nuances in the way the kids will understand. We have been fortunate and lucky to have her as our daughter’s guru for classical carnatic music. Thank you miss for all the effort you take.

What truly stands out is how Sagota Ma’am pays attention to the finer nuances of music — those subtle aspects that are often overlooked but make a world of difference in a student’s progress.

I’m so grateful to be learning with her!

What I admire most is his ability to simplify even the most technical concepts, making them easy to understand and enjoyable to practice, regardless of age or prior experience.

Anway Sir hasn't just taught me music—he has opened the door to a beautiful new journey that I hope to continue for many years to come. I am deeply grateful for his guidance, patience and unwavering support.

Thank you, Sir, for helping me fulfil a lifelong dream. Wishing you continued success and many more years of inspiring music lovers. Stay blessed!

I have been learning Harmonium in Vyas Sangeet Vidyalay for last one and half year. Our Guru Sh.Kundekar Sir teaches students personally though there is a group of six / seven students attending class at the same time. His style of teaching is very peculiar based on principle of slow and steady wins the race, meaning no hurry in learning, but one should practice more and more of a Raga before proceeding to next Raga, which brings accuracy/perfectness in playing Harmonium. I am very happy and satisfied with this style of teaching and learning.

Musical instruments are well maintained. The classes in Vyas Sangeet Vidyalaya are conducted in the evening from Monday to Saturday between 5pm to 9pm regularly, which is a convenient time duration. The Vyas Sangeet Vidyalaya also organises every year music concerts like Shravan Dhara, Deepavali Sandhya, Guru Purnima which provides an opportunity to students to showcase their talent in music. Overall it's a beautiful musical journey with Vyas Sangeet Vidyalaya 🙏
